references.label: 2016 pre-March SAT reported high-school GPA categories
references.population: Graduating seniors tested through January 2016, with a reported GPA category; latest questionnaire response, each student counted once
references.scale: Reported categories: A+, A, A-minus, B, C, D/E/F
references.limitation: Optional reported GPA categories among SAT-taking graduates, not all US students. No numerical GPA is interpolated. Target nonresponses are bounded separately.

references.population: All-status candidates in the June 2025 general baccalaureate
references.label: 2025 general baccalaureate final average
references.limitation: Published percentages are rounded; the reconstructed total is 100.0003 percent.

references.population: 2024 Common Test main-session Mathematics I/A examinees
references.label: 2024 Common Test Mathematics I/A
references.limitation: This is one subject distribution and not a whole-curriculum or credential result.

references.label: 2024 CSAT Mathematics area
references.limitation: This is the Mathematics area standardized scale and not a raw percentage score.

references.population: England summer 2024 A-level entries across all subjects
references.scale: A-level grade category, U to A*
references.label: England summer 2024 A-level outcomes
references.limitation: Subject entries across all A-level subjects in England; these results describe entries rather than an overall student grade.

references.population: 2023/24 Abitur examinations in all 16 German states
references.scale: Final grade, 1.0 best to 4.0 passing; 5.0 denotes not passed
references.label: 2024 national Abitur final grade
references.limitation: The national distribution aggregates 16 states; grade 5.0 is an analytical label for not passed, not a published final grade.

references.population: 2024 YKS candidates with a TYT examination score of at least 100
references.scale: TYT examination score, published 100 to 500 thresholds
references.label: 2024 YKS TYT examination score
references.limitation: Only candidates with a published TYT examination score of at least 100 are represented; values are resolved at 20-point thresholds.

references.label: 2024 NSC Mathematics performance band
references.limitation: Published percentages are rounded to one decimal, so results are reported as bands rather than invented exact marks.
